text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I did some serious contemplation after
the last
race!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That performance was not worthy of a
genius like
myself! My running should
have been more
exemplary!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Today, I'm going to show you
the
performance of a fully recovered
class
representative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Right! I'll restore my sullied name!
Bakuuuuushiiin!
